description: Structured medical tumor knowledge base for MRI and CT imaging patterns, radiomic feature associations, and decision support rules.
disclaimer: This knowledge base is designed strictly for academic research and intelligent decision support. It does NOT constitute medical advice or definitive diagnostic findings.

tumor_categories.name: Glioma
tumor_categories.description: Primary brain tumors originating from glial cells, typically exhibiting invasive and infiltrative growth patterns.

imaging_characteristics.t1_intensity: Hypointense to isointense relative to normal white matter
imaging_characteristics.contrast_enhancement: Variable, heterogeneous ring or patchy enhancement (high-grade glioblastoma) or minimal enhancement (low-grade)
imaging_characteristics.peritumoral_edema: Prominent, often extending along white matter tracts
imaging_characteristics.mass_effect: Moderate to severe midline shift and ventricular compression in higher grades

rules.inference: High structural heterogeneity and irregular infiltrative margin suggestive of glial neoplasm pattern.
Elevated texture contrast with low local homogeneity matches infiltrative necrotic/solid tumor matrix.

tumor_categories.name: Meningioma
tumor_categories.description: Predominantly benign extra-axial intracranial tumors arising from the arachnoid cap cells of the meninges.

imaging_characteristics.t1_intensity: Isointense to hypointense relative to gray matter
imaging_characteristics.contrast_enhancement: Strong, intense, and homogeneous enhancement with frequent dural tail sign
imaging_characteristics.mass_effect: Extra-axial mass effect with buckling of the adjacent cerebral cortex

rules.inference: Well-circumscribed, smooth globular contour characteristic of extra-axial meningeal neoplasms.
Homogeneous internal tissue composition compatible with solid meningioma architecture.

tumor_categories.name: Pituitary Tumor
tumor_categories.description: Tumor arising within the sella turcica, commonly adenomas (microadenoma <10mm or macroadenoma >=10mm with suprasellar extension).

imaging_characteristics.t1_intensity: Isointense to normal pituitary gland; microadenomas show delayed enhancement
imaging_characteristics.contrast_enhancement: Moderate enhancement, distinct from bright contrast of normal anterior pituitary
imaging_characteristics.mass_effect: Chiasmatic compression in macroadenomas with suprasellar extension

rules.inference: Circumscribed, focal sellar/parasellar lesion geometry consistent with pituitary adenoma pattern.

tumor_categories.name: No Tumor / Healthy Scan
tumor_categories.description: Anatomically normal imaging presentation without focal space-occupying lesions or pathological contrast enhancement.

imaging_characteristics.ventricles: Normal ventricular caliber without mass effect or midline shift
imaging_characteristics.parenchyma: Normal gray-white matter differentiation with expected attenuation/intensity profiles

rules.inference: Absence of significant contiguous hyperintense or hypointense segmented lesion.

tumor_categories.name: CT Space-Occupying Lesion
tumor_categories.description: Computed tomography findings demonstrating focal hypoattenuation, hyperattenuation, or rim enhancement.

imaging_characteristics.attenuation: Hypodense (edema, cyst, necrosis) or hyperdense (calcification, acute hemorrhage)
imaging_characteristics.contrast_pattern: Heterogeneous, nodular, or peripheral ring enhancement post-contrast
imaging_characteristics.hounsfield_units: Typical soft tissue range +20 to +50 HU, necrosis +10 to +25 HU, hemorrhage +60 to +90 HU

rules.inference: Focal attenuation alteration with irregular border suggestive of acute/subacute space-occupying process.
